WITH filtered_rows AS (
    SELECT cn.name AS producing_company,
           miidx.info AS rating,
           t.title AS movie
    FROM company_name AS cn
    JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
    JOIN title AS t ON mc.movie_id = t.id
    JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
    JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id
    JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.id = mi.info_type_id
    JOIN movie_info_idx AS miidx ON miidx.movie_id = mi.movie_id
    JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = miidx.info_type_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
      AND ct.kind = 'production companies'
      AND it.info = 'rating'
      AND it2.info = 'release dates'
      AND kt.kind = 'movie'
)
SELECT MIN(producing_company) AS producing_company,
       MIN(rating) AS rating,
       MIN(movie) AS movie
FROM filtered_rows
